capability.summary: Convert one local Markdown file to an HTML fragment
capability.description: Reads UTF-8 Markdown and renders an HTML fragment with Python-Markdown tables, fenced_code, and toc extensions, returning the fragment in a JSON envelope without writing a file or sanitizing HTML.
capability.problem_space: Read-only Markdown-to-HTML-fragment rendering for local content; not a full HTML document generator, sanitizer, browser renderer, template engine, or file exporter.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing UTF-8 Markdown file. Output: JSON envelope {status, tool, target, html} whose html field is a rendered fragment; no HTML file is created.
accepted_inputs: an existing UTF-8 Markdown text file compatible with Python-Markdown and its tables, fenced_code, and toc extensions
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "python-markdown", target: string, html: string}, exit 0. Missing path: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. File decoding, read, or rendering failures are uncaught and may traceback.
limitations: returns an HTML fragment inside a JSON envelope and does not create a complete document or write an HTML file
does not sanitize raw HTML from Markdown, so output must not be treated as safe for untrusted content without separate sanitization
uses only tables, fenced_code, and toc extensions; it has no timeout or size/output truncation and does not execute rendered code blocks

output_contract.description: Rendered HTML fragment carried in the `html` field of a JSON execution envelope; no file is written.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: convert a Markdown file to an HTML fragment
render Markdown tables fenced code and headings as HTML
negative_intents: write a complete HTML document to disk
render HTML in a browser or execute code blocks
